claim_limits: no human judgement is involved anywhere in this file; these are not accuracy numbers against perceived similarity
labels.json relevance is the generator's design intent (same family, role=variant), not a human ground truth
T1 is an implementation sanity check: the query's own contour is in the library, so exact_target_self_rank measures invariance, while its relevance metrics reuse the family's variants

T3 real landform candidates carry no relevance label: a pond cannot belong to the star family, so a landform in the Top-k is not a false positive in any human sense. T3 measures how far the labelled variants survive being mixed with 839 unlabelled shapes, and nothing more
E1's distances are only comparable inside this one corpus-fitted normalizer; they are not comparable to a Checkpoint B self-fitted number
E3's score is asymmetric; the run fixes d(query, candidate) and e3_direction_probe measures what the other order would have cost
timings are this machine's wall clock and will not reproduce elsewhere; the scores will

e1_normalizer.fitted_on: the frozen 179-member P0-4.5 gallery (all roles), once per run, supplied to T1/T2/T3

out_of_range_on_real_index.reading: a minmax scale fitted on stylised icons does not bound natural coastlines; the Euclidean distance in E1 is then partly a distance *outside* the fitted range, which is a property of this corpus choice, not of the descriptors

e3_direction_probe.direction_used_by_this_run: d(query, candidate): the query supplies the rotated frames, the candidate supplies the fixed frames (score_library's own loop)

settings.T1: exact target present in the library (sanity check on implementation)
settings.T2: target's rigid copies and near-duplicates removed; variants and hard negatives kept (the discriminative setting)
settings.T3: gallery shapes mixed into the real 839-candidate landform index, every candidate labelled with its provenance

protocol.coarse_window: none: every candidate is scored by every arm
protocol.labels: labels.json relevance = design intent, frozen before any arm ran
protocol.t1_metric_scope: T1's library holds the query's own contour, which an invariant arm ranks first at distance 0; the relevance metrics exclude that one row (otherwise T1 Top-1 would be 0.0 by construction) while exact_target_self_rank and results.csv report the full ranking
protocol.tie_break: stable argsort, ties by library row order (D42)
